basis: 2026-10-22 review of newly surfaced npm advisory records from Foundation runtime runs 39597802134 and 39829102419. Pillow/GitPython/PyJWT/pypdf findings are remediated separately by the reviewed Frappe Python security uplift. HRMS markdown-it is upgraded to 14.3.3. This delta covers only launch-editor/Vite records whose vulnerable behavior is confined to development/editor-launch/dev-server paths that the shipped appliance does not start.

advisories.summary: GHSA-698v-4r3x-3vcv: launch-editor escapeCmdArgs() omits % escaping on Windows
advisories.runtime_disposition_evidence: The pinned Frappe tree contains launch-editor 2.6.1 as a tooling dependency, but the TOEFL House production runtime never starts launch-editor or editor-launch middleware. Foundation runtime 39597802134 production module graph (frontend_graph-result.json SHA-256 79f7d1ba34e351d403cae22f4458138a0babfe71e6989a948cecdb7c8d896957) contains neither launch-editor nor vite. GitHub's advisory requires Windows plus launch-editor invocation; the served application process runs inside the Linux product container and the Windows host only launches Docker.
advisories.fix_path: No shipped-runtime change required. Re-triage if any production process starts launch-editor/editor middleware or if application execution moves onto a Windows Node process.

advisories.summary: GHSA-r825-w8mm-5pxw: launch-editor editor CLI flag misinterpretation
advisories.runtime_disposition_evidence: The vulnerable operation requires launchEditor/launch-editor-middleware to open attacker-influenced paths in an editor. TOEFL House production starts neither path; its production bundle graph in Foundation runtime 39597802134 excludes launch-editor and vite. The package is retained only in the pinned upstream development/build dependency tree.
advisories.fix_path: No shipped-runtime change required. Re-triage if an editor-launch endpoint is enabled in production.

advisories.summary: GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm: launch-editor fs.existsSync() bypass on Windows
advisories.runtime_disposition_evidence: GitHub states that only applications running the vulnerable editor-launch path on Windows are affected. TOEFL House application processes run in Linux containers and do not start launch-editor middleware. Foundation runtime 39597802134 production module graph excludes launch-editor and vite.
advisories.fix_path: No shipped-runtime change required. Re-triage on any Windows Node runtime or production editor-launch endpoint.

advisories.summary: GHSA-698v-4r3x-3vcv as surfaced through Vite's launch-editor development path
advisories.first_patched: Vite 6.4.4 / fixed release in each maintained line
advisories.runtime_disposition_evidence: The finding is inherited from Vite's launch-editor development/editor-opening path. TOEFL House uses Vite to build upstream SPA assets but never starts the Vite development server in production. Foundation runtime 39597802134 production module graph excludes vite and launch-editor; the Windows host does not run the Node application runtime.
advisories.fix_path: Upgrade upstream build trees when their pinned releases move; re-triage if Vite dev/preview/editor middleware is ever enabled in production.

advisories.summary: GHSA-r825-w8mm-5pxw as surfaced through Vite's launch-editor development path
advisories.first_patched: Vite 6.4.4 / fixed release in each maintained line
advisories.runtime_disposition_evidence: The vulnerable behavior is editor CLI invocation through launch-editor. Production neither starts Vite's development server nor exposes an editor-launch route. Foundation runtime 39597802134 production module graph excludes vite and launch-editor.
advisories.fix_path: Upgrade with upstream pins; re-triage if a production Vite/editor-launch process is introduced.

advisories.summary: GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm as surfaced through Vite's launch-editor development path
advisories.first_patched: Vite 6.4.4 / fixed release in each maintained line
advisories.runtime_disposition_evidence: The advisory's vulnerable editor-launch path is not a shipped server path: Vite is build/dev tooling only, the production module graph from run 39597802134 excludes vite and launch-editor, and the application runtime is Linux-containerized rather than a Windows Vite process.
advisories.fix_path: Upgrade with upstream pins; re-triage if Vite editor middleware is exposed or runtime moves to Windows Node.

advisories.summary: Vite cross-origin script execution through custom development middleware
advisories.runtime_disposition_evidence: Foundation runtime 39829102419 returned npm advisory 1242724 (GHSA-9jrq-w75r-8gcw). GitHub states the vulnerable path requires a Vite development server using custom/middleware-mode HTML transformation with an unchanged browser request URL. TOEFL House production does not start a Vite dev/preview/custom-middleware server; the same run's production frontend module graph (frontend_graph-result.json SHA-256 8abd22e33e5cf2d51fe3b23f506eaa8a3c5b77a713f169ee5100b891c4ef5203) excludes vite and launch-editor.
advisories.fix_path: Upgrade upstream build trees when their pinned releases move; re-triage immediately if Vite custom middleware or any Vite development/preview server is introduced in production.

advisories.summary: Vite dev server may expose files outside server.fs.allow on non-Windows hosts
advisories.runtime_disposition_evidence: Foundation runtime 39829102419 returned npm advisory 1242730 (GHSA-rq7h-c2jc-7f22). GitHub states exploitation requires a network-exposed Vite development server plus a matching imported project path. TOEFL House production serves prebuilt assets through Frappe and never exposes a Vite development server; the same run's production module graph excludes vite and launch-editor.
advisories.fix_path: Upgrade upstream build trees when their pinned releases move; re-triage immediately if a Vite development server is ever network-exposed in production.
